operations.name: Blank Draw Disc
operations.setup_note: Locate provisional 7 mm plate stock against the blanking-die stops and punch the circular draw blank. Release this setup only after the developed blank diameter and starting gauge are approved.

operations.name: Deep Draw Precursor Cup
operations.setup_note: Locate the disc in a qualified draw die with controlled blank holding; provisionally use one compound draw/ironing loading to produce precursor 073672. The tooling must establish the unmachined bore, minimum bottom clearance, cylindrical wall, bottom thickness and external corner while leaving a split-free rim.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the lower as-drawn OD in bored soft jaws with controlled clamping pressure, expose the open rim and indicate the unmachined bore to pick up datum A. Face the rim using the measured internal floor as the axial reference, accounting for subsequent bottom facing, then machine the exposed rim-side OD and outer chamfer.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Flip onto a low-pressure expanding mandrel locating in bore A, with the finished rim against an unlettered axial stop and the exterior bottom exposed. Face the bottom to the finished wall thickness and overall height, then rough/finish the previously gripped OD band and blend it to the first-end diameter without imposing a new finished R10 profile.

operations.name: VMC Drill Bottom Hole Pattern
operations.setup_note: Load mouth-down with the exterior bottom facing the spindle, locating on a bore-A simulator and the finished rim stop. Support the inside bottom around the drilling locations with clear breakthrough paths, and drill the center hole and four bolt-circle holes in this single fixture loading.

operations.name: Production Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the completed cup in a protective cradle and make one fast production pass over remaining sharp edges, including both sides of the bottom holes, keeping edge breaks within 0.5 mm maximum. Remove forming lubricant, coolant and chips in the same bench loading.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Gauge Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate the clean cup on a bore-A simulator and use dedicated size, height and bolt-pattern gauges under SPC sampling. Include sampled OD circularity, bottom-thickness and minimum-clearance checks, plus visual rim-integrity and burr checks, within this single final gate.

clarifications.question: What is the approved developed circular blank diameter for deep-drawn precursor 073672?
What starting material thickness is approved for drawing precursor 073672?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally use 7.0 mm plate, subject to material availability and validation against the formed wall and bottom requirements.

clarifications.question: How many separate press loadings are required by the qualified forming process for precursor 073672?
clarifications.suggested_default: Assume one qualified compound draw/ironing loading on a suitably rated in-house press; split the forming operation if the approved process requires separate redraw or restrike loadings.

clarifications.question: May the finished outside bottom transition retain the cropped as-drawn profile after OD turning and exterior bottom facing?
clarifications.suggested_default: Retain the remaining as-formed transition without a dedicated finish-radius cut; the R10 tolerance applies to precursor 073672.

assumptions.text: The route includes manufacture of deep-drawn precursor 073672 followed by machining to 073670. Its explicitly drawn, one-piece construction is retained rather than substituted with bar machining, pipe or a welded assembly; existing qualified forming tooling is assumed for this 100-piece order.

The 3 mm envelope width is the rim-flat requirement, not a developed blank width, and the 116.84 mm height and 129 mm maximum diameter describe the formed cup. Flat-stock width and height remain null until approved blank development is supplied; 7 mm starting thickness is provisional, and plate is selected because it exceeds 6 mm.

The 0.9 mm machining allowance represents the approximate nominal radial allowance between the 128 mm formed OD and 126.21 mm finished OD. Actual axial machining stock follows the separate formed-height and bottom-thickness requirements rather than this single allowance.

Press blanking replaces the sheet-metal template's laser/shear blank cutting. A qualified compound deep-draw/ironing process is provisionally assumed to achieve the precursor dimensions without intermediate annealing; separate forming loadings must be added if required by the approved process.

The sheet-metal template's pre-bend hole rule concerns flat-pattern bending and is not applied to finished holes in this deep-drawn cup. F11 and F12 are drilled after forming and turning so their positions reference the established bore axis; louvers, brake bending, hardware insertion, welding and weld dressing are absent.

F02 remains an unmachined, die-formed datum bore, so rough and finish boring are omitted. F06 is a minimum clearance envelope extending to the inside bottom surface, not a second stepped bore; the forming die physically establishes both requirements.

Saw cutting and parting are omitted because the individual blank is press-blanked and drawn. Lathe center drilling for tailstock support is unnecessary for this short cup; grooving and threading are omitted because no corresponding features exist.

Exactly two lathe setups are used. Each rough/finish pair machines only its accessible portion of the single finished OD, with the second setup completing the previously gripped band; the sub-operations do not each remove the full-length stock allowance.

Datum A supplies the bore axis only. The finished rim and measured internal floor are unlettered axial references, not invented drawing datums, and the equally spaced hole pattern requires no additional angular clocking datum.

F04 is made as a small 45-degree outer chamfer with an edge break no greater than 0.5 mm, preserving the 3 mm minimum annular flat and remaining below the 7.1 mm maximum axial transition length. No exact radius or chamfer clarification is required for the permitted alternative.

F07, F08, F09 and F10 are precursor-state requirements produced by forming. The formed bottom corner is subsequently cropped by the finished OD and bottom cuts rather than recreated as a separately toleranced finished R10 radius.

VMC work is restricted to the non-axisymmetric bottom hole pattern, with the same-diameter center manufacturing hole included to share tools and fixturing. Face, profile, pocket and slot milling are omitted because those prismatic features are absent; the rotational end faces are turned.

Spotting precedes full-size drilling of all five shallow clearance holes. Pilot drilling, deep-hole pecking, reaming, precision boring, tapping and fastener recess cutting are omitted because the specified hole depth, size tolerance and geometry do not require them; hole-edge finishing is included in the single bench pass.

No heat treatment, grinding or coating is routed for 073670. PS-135.6 belongs to the downstream 073671 process stage; the organizational overrides require one production deburr/clean operation and one final manual gauge gate, with no intermediate inspection, CMM layout or unrequested functional testing.

Blank preparation has no finished feature ID, and deburring, cleaning and inspection do not physically create the listed cup geometry. Their target lists are therefore empty rather than assigning unrelated features.
